items.one_liner_zh: EmbodiSkill 让具身智能体基于轨迹反思自演化技能，以提升跨环境的搜索、执行与状态变更能力。
items.summary_cn: 具身智能体可以从指导物体搜索、动作执行和状态变化的技能中受益，并在多样环境中复用这些技能。由于具身环境在布局、物体状态和其他执行因素上存在差异，这些技能必须根据任务执行期间生成的轨迹进行自我演化。然而，现有技能自演化方法大多面向数字环境，且通常只把轨迹转化为粗粒度的技能更新。直接将这种范式应用到具身环境，会丢失对环境约束、动作细节和技能适用条件的关键信息。本文提出 EmbodiSkill，通过技能感知的反思机制，使具身智能体能够利用执行轨迹持续改写和细化技能，从而更好地支持跨环境任务执行。

items.title: Done, But Not Sure: Disentangling World Completion from Self-Termination in Embodied Agents
items.summary: VIGIL 将具身智能体的任务完成与自我终止行为拆开评测，专门衡量终止承诺能力。
items.abstract_en: Standard embodied evaluations do not independently score whether an agent correctly commits to task completion at episode closure, a capacity we call terminal commitment. Behaviorally distinct failures--never completing the task, completing it but failing to stop, and reporting success without sufficient evidence--collapse into the same benchmark failure. We introduce VIGIL, an evaluation framework that makes terminal commitment independently measurable. Under VIGIL's default protocol, agents observe only egocentric RGB, receive no action-success signals, and must end each episode with a semantic report checked deterministically against hidden world state. This yields two separate scores: world-state completion (W) and benchmark success (B), where B additionally requires a correct terminal report. This decoupling makes four outcome categories distinguishable: missed execution, post-attainment drift, unsupported commitment, and verified success. Across 20 models on 1,000 frozen episodes, systems with comparable W differ by up to 19.7 pp in B: one model converts achieved states into correct reports, while another with near-identical execution drifts past the goal without closing. An action-feedback intervention further tests the separation: execution-oriented signals improve W broadly, yet commitment failures persist in models that do not already ground terminal reports in the achieved state. VIGIL provides a protocol that makes terminal commitment independently visible and scorable.
items.one_liner_zh: VIGIL 将具身智能体的任务完成与自我终止行为拆开评测，专门衡量终止承诺能力。
items.summary_cn: 标准具身评测通常不会独立衡量智能体在回合结束时是否正确地提交任务完成状态，本文将这种能力称为 terminal commitment。行为上不同的失败形式，例如从未完成任务、完成任务但未停止、以及在证据不足时错误报告成功，往往在现有基准中被压缩为同一种失败。本文提出 VIGIL，一个使 terminal commitment 可被独立测量的评测框架。在 VIGIL 的默认协议下，智能体不仅要完成任务，还必须在合适的时机基于充分证据作出结束判断，从而更细致地诊断具身智能体在任务闭环阶段的能力缺陷。

items.title: ConsistNav: Closing the Action Consistency Gap in Zero-Shot Object Navigation with Semantic Executive Control
items.summary: 提出无需训练的零样本 ObjectNav 框架 ConsistNav，通过语义执行控制减少探索与追踪之间的反复摇摆。
items.abstract_en: Zero-shot object navigation has advanced rapidly with open-vocabulary detectors, image--text models, and language-guided exploration. However, even after current methods detect a plausible target hypothesis, the agent may still oscillate between exploration and pursuit, or abandon the object near success. We identify this failure mode as an action consistency gap: semantic evidence is repeatedly reinterpreted at each step without persistent commitment across the episode. We introduce ConsistNav, a training-free zero-shot ObjectNav framework built around a semantic executive composed of three coordinated modules: Finite-State Executive Controller stages target pursuit through guarded semantic phases; Persistent Candidate Memory accumulates cross-frame target evidence into stable object hypotheses; and Stability-Aware Action Control suppresses rotational stagnation, ineffective pursuit, and unverified stopping. This design changes neither the detector nor the low-level planner; instead, it controls when semantic evidence should influence navigation and when it should be suppressed or revisited. We conduct extensive experiments on HM3D and MP3D, where ConsistNav achieves state-of-the-art results among compared zero-shot ObjectNav methods and improves SR by 11.4% and SPL by 7.9% over the controlled baseline on MP3D. Ablation studies and real-world deployment experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed executive mechanism.
items.one_liner_zh: 提出无需训练的零样本 ObjectNav 框架 ConsistNav，通过语义执行控制减少探索与追踪之间的反复摇摆。
items.summary_cn: 零样本目标导航受益于开放词表检测器、图文模型和语言引导探索而迅速发展。然而，即便现有方法检测到了看似合理的目标假设，智能体仍可能在探索与追逐之间来回振荡，或者在接近成功时放弃目标。我们将这种失败模式归因于动作一致性缺口：语义证据在每一步都会被重新解释，而缺乏跨整段 episode 的持续承诺。我们提出 ConsistNav，这是一个无需训练的零样本 ObjectNav 框架，其核心是由三个协同模块组成的语义执行器：Finite-State Executive Controller 通过受保护的语义阶段来推进目标追踪；Persistent Candidate Memory 将跨帧目标证据累积为稳定的目标假设；Stability-Aware Action Control 抑制旋转停滞、无效追逐和未经验证的停止。该设计既不改变检测器，也不改变底层规划器；它只是控制语义证据何时应影响导航，以及何时应被抑制或重新审视。我们在 HM3D 和 MP3D 上进行了大量实验，其中 ConsistNav 在所比较的零样本 ObjectNav 方法中取得了 state-of-the-art 结果，并在 MP3D 上相较于受控基线将 SR 提升 11.4%、SPL 提升 7.9%。消融实验和真实世界部署实验进一步证明了所提执行机制的有效性与鲁棒性。

items.title: High Precision Hydraulic Excavator Control for Heavy-Duty Grading
items.summary: 提出面向重载液压挖掘机高精度平地作业的自主控制器，在两类液压架构上都实现了专家级速度与更高精度。
items.abstract_en: High-precision heavy-duty grading is a common step in earthworks, traditionally carried out manually by skilled operators. Removing a significant amount of material while achieving a high-precision surface requires substantial machine-specific experience. Different hydraulic architectures react differently to operator inputs and soil interaction forces, which makes generalizable controllers challenging. In this paper, we present an autonomous controller that achieves high-precision grading at expert-operator speed on Load Sensing and Negative Flow Control machines alike. We split our controller into two parts: (1) a hydraulic-aware low-level loop that is hydraulic architecture-specific and (2) a path-tracking layer that coordinates joint motions and responses. Through a calibration process, our technique is applicable to load-sensing and negative-flow-control machinery. To showcase its versatility, we benchmark our approach on two excavators with different hydraulics and compare it against a commercial state-of-the-art solution. Our technique (RMSE 1.8~cm) outperforms the commercial solution (RMSE 4.7~cm) in precision by a factor of 2.6 and improves machine usage by leveraging the maximum function pressure, as opposed to commercial solutions that stall prematurely.
items.one_liner_zh: 提出面向重载液压挖掘机高精度平地作业的自主控制器，在两类液压架构上都实现了专家级速度与更高精度。
items.summary_cn: 高精度重载平地作业是土方工程中的常见步骤，传统上由熟练操作员手动完成。在移除大量物料的同时实现高精度表面，需要大量与具体机器相关的经验。不同液压架构对操作输入和土壤交互力的响应不同，这使得可泛化控制器的设计充满挑战。本文提出一种自主控制器，能够在 Load Sensing 和 Negative Flow Control 两类机器上，以专家操作员的速度实现高精度平地。我们的控制器分为两部分：(1) 面向液压特性的底层控制回路，其设计依赖具体液压架构；(2) 用于协调关节运动与响应的路径跟踪层。通过一个校准流程，该方法可适用于 load-sensing 和 negative-flow-control 机械。为展示其通用性，我们在两台液压系统不同的挖掘机上进行了基准测试，并与一种商用 state-of-the-art 方案比较。我们的技术以 1.8 cm 的 RMSE 达到比商用方案 4.7 cm 更高的精度，提升幅度为 2.6 倍，同时通过利用最大功能压力提高了机器利用率，而商用方案会过早停滞。

items.title: Continuum Robot Modeling with Action Conditioned Flow Matching
items.summary: 面向腱驱动连续体机器人，提出基于 action-conditioned flow matching 的自建模方法，用于从电机动作预测稳态三维形状。
items.abstract_en: Predicting the shape of tendon driven continuum robots (TDCRs) at steady state from actuation remains challenging due to continuous deformation, complex tendon routing, compliance, friction, and fabrication variability. In this paper, we address this problem as kinematic self modeling conditioned on action. We present a lightweight 3D printed TDCR hardware platform and an RGB-D data collection pipeline with multiple cameras, and we learn a point cloud flow matching model that maps motor actuation states to the robot's settled 3D geometry. The model is trained from randomly sampled quasi static configurations and evaluated on test motor commands within the same TDCR design family and actuation range. We compare against prior 3D deformable object and robot self modeling approaches in both MuJoCo simulation and real hardware experiments. Experiments on simulated 2-, 3-, and 5-module TDCRs and real 2- and 3-module robots show improved shape prediction accuracy under CD and EMD metrics. We further show in simulation that the same conditional formulation generalizes to tip payload as a conditioning input, enabling payload conditioned steady-state shape prediction. These results demonstrate a data driven self modeling framework for quasi static TDCR geometry prediction.
items.one_liner_zh: 面向腱驱动连续体机器人，提出基于 action-conditioned flow matching 的自建模方法，用于从电机动作预测稳态三维形状。
items.summary_cn: 由于存在连续形变、复杂的腱走线、柔顺性、摩擦以及制造差异，从驱动信号预测腱驱动连续体机器人 (TDCR) 的稳态形状仍然具有挑战性。本文将该问题表述为由动作条件化的运动学自建模。我们提出了一个轻量级 3D 打印 TDCR 硬件平台和一个带多相机的 RGB-D 数据采集流程，并学习了一个 point cloud flow matching 模型，将电机驱动状态映射到机器人的稳态三维几何形状。该模型在随机采样的准静态构型上训练，并在同一 TDCR 设计家族和驱动范围内的测试电机指令上评估。我们在 MuJoCo 仿真和真实硬件实验中，将该方法与以往的 3D 可变形对象和机器人自建模方法进行比较。针对仿真的 2、3、5 模块 TDCR 以及真实的 2、3 模块机器人，实验在 CD 和 EMD 指标下都显示出更优的形状预测精度。我们还在仿真中表明，同一条件化形式可以推广到将末端负载作为条件输入，从而实现按负载条件化的稳态形状预测。这些结果展示了一种面向准静态 TDCR 几何预测的数据驱动自建模框架。

items.title: Constraint-Aware Diffusion Priors for High-Fidelity and Versatile Quadruped Locomotion
items.summary: Diff-CAST 用 diffusion motion prior、对称命令条件化和约束强化学习提升四足机器人 locomotion 的多样性、跟踪一致性与上机安全性。
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning combined with imitation learning has significantly advanced biomimetic quadrupedal locomotion. However, scaling these frameworks to massive, multi-source datasets exposes fundamental bottlenecks. First, traditional GAN-based discriminators are prone to mode collapse, struggling to capture diverse motion distributions from uncurated datasets. Second, existing kinematic priors suffer from out-of-distribution (OOD) tracking conflicts, leading to severe unintended heading drifts during complex maneuvers. Furthermore, deploying unconstrained priors to physical hardware poses critical safety risks by disregarding actuator dynamics. To overcome these challenges, we propose Diff-CAST (Diffusion-guided Constraint-Aware Symmetric Tracking), a novel motion prior framework leveraging the multi-modal distribution modeling capabilities of diffusion models for stylistic rewards. Diff-CAST effectively replaces traditional GAN discriminators, unlocking robust data scaling on heterogeneous collections. To ensure high-fidelity intent execution and reliable real-world deployment, we introduce a comprehensive Sim2Re architecture integrating Symmetric Augmented Command Conditioning (SACC) for drift-free tracking, and Constrained RL for hardware safety. Experiments on a quadruped demonstrate that Diff-CAST mitigates mode collapse, enables seamless transitions between diverse skills, and ensures robust, hardware-compliant locomotion.
items.one_liner_zh: Diff-CAST 用 diffusion motion prior、对称命令条件化和约束强化学习提升四足机器人 locomotion 的多样性、跟踪一致性与上机安全性。
items.summary_cn: 强化学习与模仿学习的结合显著推动了仿生四足运动的发展。然而，将这些框架扩展到大规模、多源数据集时会暴露出根本瓶颈。首先，传统基于 GAN 的判别器容易发生 mode collapse，难以捕捉未经清洗数据集中的多样化运动分布。其次，现有运动学先验会遭遇 out-of-distribution (OOD) 跟踪冲突，在复杂机动中导致严重的非预期航向漂移。此外，将无约束先验部署到真实硬件会因忽视执行器动力学而带来关键安全风险。为解决这些问题，我们提出 Diff-CAST (Diffusion-guided Constraint-Aware Symmetric Tracking)，这是一种新的 motion prior 框架，利用 diffusion model 的多模态分布建模能力来提供风格化奖励。Diff-CAST 有效替代了传统 GAN 判别器，从而在异构数据集合上实现稳健的数据扩展。为确保高保真意图执行和可靠的真实世界部署，我们引入了完整的 Sim2Re 架构，其中包括用于无漂移跟踪的 Symmetric Augmented Command Conditioning (SACC)，以及用于硬件安全的 Constrained RL。四足机器人实验表明，Diff-CAST 能缓解 mode collapse，实现不同技能之间的无缝切换，并确保符合硬件约束的稳健 locomotion。

items.title: HeteroGenManip: Generalizable Manipulation For Heterogeneous Object Interactions
items.summary: HeteroGenManip 分解“在哪操作”和“如何操作”，提升异构对象交互的泛化操作能力。
items.abstract_en: Generalizable manipulation involving cross-type object interactions is a critical yet challenging capability in robotics. To reliably accomplish such tasks, robots must address two fundamental challenges: ``where to manipulate'' (contact point localization) and ``how to manipulate'' (subsequent interaction trajectory planning). Existing foundation-model-based approaches often adopt end-to-end learning that obscures the distinction between these stages, exacerbating error accumulation in long-horizon tasks. Furthermore, they typically rely on a single uniform model, which fails to capture the diverse, category-specific features required for heterogeneous objects. To overcome these limitations, we propose HeteroGenManip, a task-conditioned, two-stage framework designed to decouple initial grasp from complex interaction execution. First, Foundation-Correspondence-Guided Grasp module leverages structural priors to align the initial contact state, thereby significantly reducing the pose uncertainty of grasping. Subsequently, Multi-Foundation-Model Diffusion Policy (MFMDP) routes objects to category-specialized foundation models, integrating fine-grained geometric information with highly-variable part features via a dual-stream cross-attention mechanism. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that HeteroGenManip achieves robust intra-category shape and pose generalization. The framework achieves an average 31\% performance improvement in simulation tasks with broad type setting, alongside a 36.7\% gain across four real-world tasks with different interaction types.

items.title: MVB-Grasp: Minimum-Volume-Box Filtering of Diffusion-based Grasps for Frontal Manipulation
items.summary: MVB-Grasp 用最小体积包围盒几何先验筛选 diffusion 抓取结果，提升正向抓取成功率。
items.abstract_en: State-of-the-art 6-DoF grasp generators excel on tabletop benchmarks with overhead cameras but struggle in frontal grasping scenarios on low-cost manipulators with constrained workspaces, where kinematic limits and approach-direction constraints cause high failure rates. We address this challenge for the Unitree Z1 arm by proposing MVB-Grasp, a novel grasping stack that injects a Minimum Volume Bounding Box (MVBB) geometric prior into diffusion-based grasp generation to dramatically improve success rates in frontal, workspace-constrained settings. Our key scientific contributions are threefold: (i) an MVBB-based geometric filter that exploits oriented bounding-box face normals to reject grasps approaching through the table or misaligned with accessible object faces in O(N) time; (ii) a combined re-scoring function that blends learned discriminator scores with face-alignment geometry {\alpha}=0.85, specifically calibrated for the Z1's frontal workspace and kinematic constraints; and (iii) a systematic MuJoCo evaluation protocol measuring grasp success across object types, distances, lateral positions, and pitch orientations to validate embodiment-specific performance. We implement MVB-Grasp on a Unitree Z1 arm with an Intel RealSense D405 camera, integrating YOLOv8 object detection, GraspGen for candidate generation, Principal Component Analysis (PCA)-based MVBB fitting, and inverse-kinematics trajectory planning. Experiments across 81 MuJoCo episodes (cylinder, asymmetric box, waterbottle) demonstrate that MVB-Grasp achieves 59.3% success versus 24.7% for vanilla GraspGen, a 2.4x improvement, by filtering geometrically infeasible candidates and prioritizing face-aligned grasps suited to the Z1's frontal approach constraints. Real-world trials confirm that the MVBB prior substantially improves grasp reliability on constrained, low-cost manipulators without requiring model retraining.
